user.title: Niko Access cloud account
user.description: Log in with the same account you use in the Niko Access Control app.

error.verification_required: The cloud wants an extra verification step (captcha or SMS). Log in once in the Niko app on your phone, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Niko cloud. Check the logs for details.

data.lock_ids: Lock IDs (comma separated, leave empty for auto)
data.camera_ip: Door station IP address (enables live video)

data_description.lock_ids: Empty: one 'Open door' button per lock marked enabled on the door station. Otherwise e.g. 3 or 1,3 (IDs 1-4: station locks A/B, system relays A/B).
data_description.scan_interval: How often the cloud is asked whether someone is ringing. Lower is faster but heavier on the cloud.
data_description.camera_ip: LAN IP of the door station (e.g. 10.6.2.6). Auto-detected on your network; leave empty to disable the camera. Home Assistant must be on the same LAN. Use a DHCP reservation so the address stays stable.

error.invalid_lock_ids: Enter numbers separated by commas, e.g. 3 or 1,3, or leave empty.
error.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IP address, e.g. 10.6.2.6, or leave empty.
